headline: Moderna shares fall after cancer vaccine data leaks on social media
summary: Shares of Moderna declined significantly after clinical trial data for its experimental cancer vaccine was published on social media platforms.
why: Moderna Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on mRNA vaccines and therapeutic treatments.

impacts.name: Moderna Inc.
impacts.why: Unofficial distribution of clinical data prompted uncertainty among investors.

why_moved: Social media leaks regarding clinical trial data induced selling pressure on Moderna stock.
